recognize_zh: 周邊血液中的血小板偏大、呈淡灰藍色，幾乎看不到紫色 α 顆粒，看起來像「幽靈」血小板，這是灰色血小板症候群（gray platelet syndrome）的典型形態，易被誤診為 ITP。
features: Enlarged platelets approaching or exceeding the size of a small red cell
Platelets pale gray-blue and nearly devoid of purple azurophilic (alpha) granules
Irregular, ghost-like platelet outlines with homogeneous hyaline cytoplasm
Few platelets per field, consistent with thrombocytopenia
Red cells normocytic and normochromic; no leukocyte abnormalities in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows decreased platelets, and the platelets present are large with pale gray-blue, agranular cytoplasm and irregular ghost-like outlines, lacking the normal purple granulomere. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are suggestive of gray platelet syndrome (NBEAL2-related alpha-granule deficiency); confirmation by electron microscopy showing absent alpha granules and reduced platelet factor 4/P-selectin content is recommended, and the patient should not be labeled as ITP.

ddx.vs: ITP may show large platelets but they retain normal purple alpha granules, and marrow megakaryocytes are not associated with myelofibrosis or emperipolesis.
Artifactual hypogranular platelets occur in delayed specimens and are corrected on a fresh smear, whereas GPS persists with EM-confirmed alpha-granule absence.
BSS shows giant platelets with normal granulation and absent ristocetin-induced aggregation due to GPIb-IX-V deficiency.
MYH9 disorders show giant granulated platelets with Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils.
